class.name: BehaviorCallMethod
class.brief_description: Calls a method on the agent.
class.description: Calls [member method] on the agent, or on the node at [member node] from it, with [member arguments]. It fails if the method returns [code]false[/code], and succeeds otherwise: a way to use the agent's own code as an action or a condition without writing a task.

members.member: What the method is called with.
A node relative to the agent to call it on, or empty for the agent itself.
